Principal Data Engineer
Boston, Massachusetts
$150,000 - $170,000

,


Are you looking for an interesting opportunity to leverage technology and contribute to improving the affordability and accessibility of healthcare globally? The perfect person for this role is an experienced data engineer who will be a key contributor and problem solver. You will lead engineering initiatives and communicate technical requirements to a team of junior developers.

,


THE COMPANY

,

Our client is a one of the largest health insurance companies in the United States. They are keen to leverage technology for the purpose of transforming the healthcare insurance space. As the Principal Data Engineer leading the team, you will have autonomy over the business and significant influence on engineering projects moving forward.

,


THE ROLE

,

This is the perfect role for you if you are a big picture thinker who is keen to solve problems and develop Big Data solutions. You are an excellent communicator and confident presenting technical details to colleagues ranging from junior engineers to senior-level management. This is a very hands-on role with the Engineering team, which is working on an innovative project that contributes to the company's aim to improve the affordability and accessibility of healthcare.
In particular you can expect to be involved with the following:

,
  • Developing efficient and robust programming in Java
  • Play a leading role in designing and building out Big Data solutions
  • Application and development of cloud architecture and data pipelines
  • Leading the entire build out of backend data structures to support mobile applications
,


YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

,
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical disciplines
  • Very advanced expertise in programming with Java, Python, or Scala
  • Highly experienced in Big Data solutions, particularly Hadoop and Spark
  • Exposure to cloud computing technologies such as AWS
,


THE BENEFITS

,

The salary for this role is up to $170,000 depending on your experience. You will be privy to great benefits including an annual bonus, equity, and a fantastic healthcare package.

]

Description:
1. Creative & Design Development

Lead the creation of visual concepts, layouts, and graphic designs for mall campaigns, promotions, events, and tenant collaborations.

Design digital and print materials including posters, banners, social media assets, LED screen visuals, event backdrops, signage, and wayfinding materials.

Ensure all artwork aligns with brand identity, marketing strategy, and mall positioning.

Develop thematic concepts and mood boards for seasonal décor (festive decorations, mall ambience setups, photo spots, etc.).

2. Art & Decoration Management

Oversee the planning and execution of mall-wide décor, installations, and visual merchandising elements.

Coordinate with vendors, decorators, contractors, and event teams to ensure timely and accurate installation of decorations.

Review décor proposals, materials, production samples, and mock-ups to maintain quality and brand adherence.

Conduct on-site checks to ensure setup quality, safety, and visual consistency.

3. Team Leadership & Project Supervision

Manage and mentor a creative team of two designers, ensuring clear work allocation, adherence to timelines, and quality output.

Provide creative guidance, feedback, and daily supervision to enhance team performance.

Conduct design reviews and maintain a high standard of visual output.

Coordinate project workflows and collaborate closely with marketing, events, leasing, and operations teams.

4. Production & Vendor Coordination

Prepare production-ready artwork and liaise with printers and fabricators to ensure accurate color, material, and finishing quality.

Evaluate quotations, compare vendor proposals, and recommend cost-effective options.

Oversee the mall’s inventory of design assets, décor items, and props.

5. Brand & Quality Assurance

Maintain consistency of visual language across all touchpoints.

Ensure compliance with brand guidelines for both mall branding and tenant co-branding.

Continuously improve creative standards by tracking design trends in retail, shopping malls, and lifestyle industries.
